cd /app/doomgeneric/doomgeneric && cat > Makefile.mips << 'EOF'
################################################################
#
# Makefile for MIPS cross-compilation of DoomGeneric
#

CROSS_COMPILE=mips-linux-gnu-
CC=$(CROSS_COMPILE)gcc
AR=$(CROSS_COMPILE)ar
LINKER=$(CROSS_COMPILE)ld
OBJCOPY=$(CROSS_COMPILE)objcopy
OBJDUMP=$(CROSS_COMPILE)objdump

CFLAGS=-Os -march=mips32 -mabi=32 -static -fno-builtin
CFLAGS+=-Wall -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-implicit-function-declaration
CFLAGS+=-DNORMALUNIX -DLINUX -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE

LDFLAGS=-static -Wl,--gc-sections

# subdirectory for objects
